contracts.title: Master Services Agreement for Desktop & Infrastructure Support

clauses.title: Scope of Support Services
clauses.text: Kestrel IT Services shall provide Tier-1 and Tier-2 on-site desktop maintenance, peripheral hardware diagnostics, network endpoint monitoring, and user workstation deployment across all Meridian Global Services Mumbai facilities.

clauses.title: Service Level Commitments
clauses.text: Vendor shall maintain a minimum first-response resolution rate of 92% and overall system availability of 99.5% during core operating hours (08:00 to 20:00 IST Monday through Saturday). Priority-1 desktop outages affecting more than five active workstations shall be resolved within two (2) hours.

clauses.title: Remedies for SLA Failure
clauses.text: In the event Vendor misses designated SLA thresholds, Vendor shall submit a root-cause remediation memorandum within five (5) business days. No financial deductions, service credits, or liquidated penalties shall apply unless non-performance persists continuously for three consecutive quarters.

clauses.title: Confidentiality & Endpoint Access
clauses.text: Vendor engineers shall have privileged diagnostic access to client-facing production terminals, diagnostic telemetry, and corporate network interfaces strictly necessary for performing maintenance obligations.

clauses.title: Term of Agreement
clauses.text: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for an Initial Term of twelve (12) calendar months, expiring on 28-Feb-2026.

clauses.title: Renewal and Evergreen Extension
clauses.text: Unless either party serves written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days prior to the expiration of the Initial Term or any Renewal Term, this Agreement shall automatically renew for a successive period of twenty-four (24) months ('Renewal Term') on the prevailing fee schedule without price reduction or restructuring.

clauses.title: Termination for Cause
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement only upon sixty (60) days written notice following a material breach that remains unremedied after a mandatory thirty (30) day cure period. Neither party may terminate for convenience during the Renewal Term.

contracts.title: Facility Operations and Housekeeping Services Agreement

clauses.title: Facility Hygiene Standards
clauses.text: Brightline Facilities shall supply trained housekeeping workforce, industrial cleaning consumables, and sanitization schedules across 4 floors of the Mumbai delivery centre.

clauses.title: Service Level Benchmark
clauses.text: Facility cleanliness checklists must be signed off twice daily. High-traffic client presentation suites and executive boardrooms must achieve 100% audit-readiness at all times.

clauses.title: Termination for Cause
clauses.text: Client may terminate this contract upon thirty (30) days written notice if vendor fails to remedy reported operational deficiencies.

contracts.title: Facility Operations and Housekeeping Services Agreement (Amended)

clauses.title: SLA Penalties and Service Credits
clauses.text: In the event of any verified failure to meet hygiene or audit readiness standards, Brightline Facilities shall credit 5% of monthly billing per breach, capped at 25% of total monthly billing.

clauses.title: Termination for Convenience
clauses.text: Meridian Global Services reserves the unconditional right to terminate this agreement without cause, liability, or penalty upon providing ninety (90) days written notice.

contracts.title: Master Cloud Services Agreement - AI Call Transcription (DRAFT)

clauses.title: Audio Processing Scope
clauses.text: Parlo Transcription shall ingest recorded customer telephone interactions, support agent call audio, and transcription telemetry to produce speech-to-text transcripts with speaker diarization.

clauses.title: Commercial Terms and Invoicing
clauses.text: Client shall remit an initial advance payment of thirty percent (30%) of estimated annual fees upon contract execution prior to API endpoint provisioning and tenant configuration.

clauses.title: Infrastructure and Cloud Hosting
clauses.text: Transcription pipelines and machine learning inference workloads are processed using distributed cloud infrastructure in commercial public cloud regions selected dynamically based on compute capacity.

clauses.title: Sub-processors and Data Access
clauses.text: Vendor reserves the right to engage third-party model inference providers and outsourced annotation contractors to improve transcription turnaround and maintain quality.

clauses.title: Security Incident Notification
clauses.text: Vendor shall notify Client of any confirmed security compromise or unauthorised access to audio data within fourteen (14) business days of verification.
